t: You're at the Fortune Theatre on Russell Street, close to Covent Garden. It's a West End theatre with 432 seats, so it's an intimate house rather than a grand one. From 1989 until 2023 it was home to the long-running play The Woman in Black. The theatre was designed by the architect Ernest Schaufelberg, who lived from 1892 to 1970. If you're curious, have a look at the entrance and the frontage, which is where a theatre like this shows its character.
